The Atlanta Hawks (2-0), first in the Southeast and the East, host the Houston Rockets (2-0), first in the Southwest and third in the West, in the Hawks' third game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams on two-game winning streaks. Atlanta is 2-0 on the road and has yet to play at home, while Houston is 1-0 at home and 1-0 on the road. Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture) are out for the Hawks, and Fred VanVleet (rest), Reed Sheppard (knee bruise) and Steven Adams (rest) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions for Houston.

The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Hawks lost 0-2 to Houston in the 2025-26 season series, most recently 117-95 in Houston on March 20, 2026.
